subject: Launch coverage & sprint asks — canary week exception plan
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Patricia Gomez <pgomez@acmeai.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Launch coverage & sprint asks — canary week exception plan

Team,

We have one week until Acme's canary starts (week of 3/15). I want to align on two things quickly: 1) the set of product asks that must land before canary, and 2) the coverage/exception plan if we hit a blocker during canary. High level asks I have so far: model pin v2.1, KV cache warmup script, and a docs + runbook for oncall.

Can each of you reply with a concrete owner, ETA, and any blocking dependencies by EOD Wednesday? If we can't meet any ETA, call it out and propose a contingency.

I've attached an early canary_runbook_v1.pdf and an enablement_roster.xlsx — use the roster to add oncall names.

Preliminary list:
- Product: pin v2.1, rollout window (Priyom)
- Runtime/ops: KV cache warmup, autoscale threshold (Logan)
- Docs/Enablement: runbook + runthrough slides (Lauren/Marissa)
- Analytics: latency/quality dashboard (Marcus)

I'll collect responses and push a short, single-page exception plan for leadership sign-off by Friday.

Thanks,
Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
Head of Billing & Launch Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch coverage & sprint asks — canary week exception plan

Sean — thanks for the kickoff. Quick responses below so you have a digest: 

- Docs/runbook: Lauren and I will split the runbook + runthrough deck. ETA: draft by Thu 3/11, final by Mon 3/15 after Friday review. Owner: Lauren (runbook), Marissa (slides).
- Enablement roster: I filled the roster with SRE + CS liaisons and saved as enablement_roster.xlsx (see attachment).
- Training slot: propose Wed 3/10 11am PT for a dry run with Acme. Lauren, can you host?

If we find gaps in the runbook that require product changes (e.g., forced cache invalidation), we'll flag as an exception and escalate.

Marissa
Senior Technical Writer, Customer Enablement

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch coverage & sprint asks — canary week exception plan

On Tue, Mar 9, 2027 at 10:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Sean — thanks for the kickoff. Quick responses below so you have a digest:
> 
> - Docs/runbook: Lauren and I will split the runbook + runthrough deck. ETA: draft by Thu 3/11, final by Mon 3/15 after Friday review. Owner: Lauren (runbook), Marissa (slides).

Thanks — from an Ops perspective:
- KV cache warmup script: I can deliver a first-pass script by Fri 3/12. Owner: Logan. Need a test vector and expected warmup time from product (Priyom).
- Autoscale thresholds: I'll propose conservative thresholds for canary by Thu 3/11. If telemetry spikes >120% above baseline for 10 minutes, we automatically fallback to a lower-capacity variant.
- Exception path: my recommended fallback is to route Acme traffic to the dedicated low-latency pool + enable short-term burst capacity. That requires a reserved burst ticket to infra; Marcus, can you confirm cost delta?

Attachments: canary_runbook_v1.pdf (reference)

Logan
Principal SRE, Runtime

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch coverage & sprint asks — canary week exception plan

Thanks — short product update and blockers: 
1) Model pin v2.1: We can pin v2.1 and ship a config toggle by 3/13 EOD. Owner: Priyom. Blocker: final perf test from Runtime (Logan) and one small validation test suite (quality gate).
2) KV cache expected behavior: TTL semantics change in v2.1 — I will add expected warmup sequences to the test vector by Thu 3/11.
3) Forced invalidation: product will not expose a forced invalidation API before canary. If Ops needs it we should treat it as an exception and use routing fallback.

Proposed contingency: if warmup doesn't reach baseline in 30 minutes, route to variant-a (stable quantized profile) and pause model rollout. That should be automated in the fallback playbook.

Priyom
Product Manager, Serving

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Patricia Gomez <pgomez@acmeai.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch coverage & sprint asks — canary week exception plan

Folks — I reviewed the runbook and ran the early checklist against the staging flow. Quick notes (docs-gap-list.md attached):
- Missing quick recovery steps for the operator when the KV warmup stalls (need explicit commands and expected outputs).
- Need a short one-pager for CS on "what to tell the customer" if we pause a rollout — draft attached to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cCanary
- Training: Wed 3/10 11am PT confirmed. I'll run the dry run and record it for the Acme CS team.

If product confirms the 3/13 pin ETA and Logan confirms the warmup script by 3/12, docs will be ready and we can proceed with the canary. Otherwise we need an exception call and a proposed approval chain.

Lauren
Lead Enablement Manager

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Patricia Gomez <pgomez@acmeai.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch coverage & sprint asks — canary week exception plan

Thanks all for the quick turn. Summary / action items (short, please follow up in thread if anything is off):

1) Priyom — pin v2.1 config toggle by 2027-03-13 EOD. Blocker: Logan perf test.
2) Logan — KV warmup script by 2027-03-12 EOD; autoscale proposal by 2027-03-11. Confirm cost delta for burst mode (Marcus).
3) Lauren/Marissa — runbook + slides final by 2027-03-15 09:00; record dry run (Wed 3/10 11am PT) and upload recording to Drive.
4) Marcus — confirm analytics dashboard baseline and cost delta on fallback by Mon 3/15.
5) Exception plan: if warmup < baseline after 30m, route to variant-a and pause rollout; Marcus and Logan to trigger fallback and notify leadership. Sean will prepare the one-pager for leadership sign-off on Friday.

Patricia: we'll record the dry run and share the one-pager before go/no-go. Appreciate the partnership — we'll keep you in the loop if we need to pause.

I'll circulate a one-pager with these action items + approval chain by EOD tomorrow. If anyone needs to reassign ownership, say so now.

Sean
Head of Billing & Launch Operations
